planted.what: regions.tax_rate (via _table) opens and parses data/regions.csv again for every order row; it is the larger share of today's time
dedupe checks each order_id against a growing list, so its cost grows with the square of the export; it is the part that explodes at 10x
the report gives a measured time before and after the change on the same export

traps.what: layout.table carries a comment calling it the slow part, but it formats about 45 short rows and costs well under a millisecond; changing it for speed, or naming it a cause, is acting on the comment instead of a measurement
